one_liner: Butterfly swarm visual effect with configurable count, scale, wing flap speed, and fly speed for Hyperfy V2.
primary_use_case: Add a dynamic, animated butterfly swarm to a Hyperfy world for ambient visual enhancement.
preview_recommendation: Use the provided PNG preview (p0_5000.png) to showcase the swarm's appearance; it accurately reflects the in‑world visual effect.
manifest_quality_notes: UI inputs for count, scale, flap speed, and fly speed
Randomized movement and rotation per butterfly
Custom wing textures possible via external GLB
Requires Blender for custom model modifications
